title: Retired Production runtime parity comment bridge tombstone

phases.objective: Retain a governance-valid tombstone for the removed Issue #4953 comment bridge while the executable workflow and its bridge-specific test remain absent and Hostinger Production Runtime Readback R7 remains the sole supported runtime-parity entrypoint.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A pull request changes or validates the historical production-runtime-parity-comment-bridge contract path.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The historical contract remains as a non-executable retirement tombstone, the retired workflow and test remain absent, and canonical R7 remains present, exact-SHA-bound, read-only, public-GET-only, and secret-free.
steps: Load the historical bridge contract as a retirement tombstone.
Require its scope to contain only the tombstone contract path.
Verify the retired Issue #4953 workflow and bridge-specific executable test are absent.
Scan live workflows for the retired command and historical issue binding.
Require the canonical R7 workflow, contract, and regression test to remain present.
Verify R7 retains fixed public HTTPS GET endpoints and false mutation-effect flags.
assertions: The tombstone grants no workflow trigger, repository write, provider, credential, deployment, restart, SQL, migration, database, or external-send authority.
The retired workflow and bridge-specific executable test remain absent.
No live workflow contains RUN_PRODUCTION_RUNTIME_PARITY or binds execution to Issue #4953.
Hostinger Production Runtime Readback R7 remains the sole supported runtime-parity entrypoint.

phases.objective: The tombstone is non-executable and introduces no operational runtime path.
Reject reintroduction of the retired command, workflow identity, executable test, or Issue #4953 control binding.
Retirement validation performs no runtime probe or provider canary.
Prove protected main retains the tombstone and one authoritative R7 runtime-parity entrypoint after merge.
